newsitem.title: USA: Trigon adopts shareholder rights plan.
newsitem.headline: Trigon adopts shareholder rights plan.

text.p: Trigon Healthcare Inc said its board has adopted a shareholder rights plan designed to give shareholders fair and equal treatment if the company should become a takeover target.
The managed health care company, which has about 1.9 million members, said the rights are not being distributed in response to any specific effort to acquire control of Trigon.

Under the plan, the board created series A junior participating preferred shares and has declared a dividend distribution of one preferred share purchase right on each outstanding share of Trigon class A common shares.

Each right would entitle shareholders to buy one one-hundredth of the new preferred shares at an exercise price of $100. Subject to certain exceptions, the rights become exercisable if a person or group acquires 10 percent or more of Trigon's common shares or announces a tender offer for 10 percent or more of Trigon's common shares.
Trigon's board will be entitled to redeem the right at $.001 per right any time before a person acquires 10 percent or more of Trigon's outstanding common shares.
The company said its board has set July 29, as the record date for the distribution. The rights plan expires in 2007, it said.
